name: Boarding ramps and gangways
description: The ramp or gangway between a supply vessel or crew boat and the boat landing. It is sized for the vessel's relative motion and the personnel and luggage load.

gaps.what: Ramp length, rated load and motion envelope
gaps.why: No page read gives a boarding ramp length, load rating or motion envelope.
gaps.next_action: Fetch a gangway datasheet and record length, rated load and motion envelope

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
